description: This file declares exported API functions for the Http Bmo Request object in a BroadWay Service Delivery System, related to HTTP protocol handling, including creation, removal, initialization, and CGI content handling functions.

methods.name: HttpCreateBmoReq
methods.description: Creates a new instance of the Http Bmo Request object with specified context handles.

methods.name: HttpBmoReqCreate
methods.description: Initializes a new Http Bmo Request object.

methods.name: HttpBmoReqRemove
methods.description: Removes or deallocates a specified Http Bmo Request object.

methods.name: HttpBmoReqEnrollObjects
methods.description: Enlists or registers objects necessary for Http Bmo Request object functioning.

methods.name: HttpBmoReqInitialize
methods.description: Initializes the Http Bmo Request object, setting up internal states.

methods.name: HttpBmoReqCgiGetFormContent
methods.description: Retrieves the form content from a CGI request.

methods.name: HttpBmoReqCgiGetContentType
methods.description: Gets the content type and subtype for a CGI request.

methods.name: HttpBmoReqCgiGetBoundaryDelimiter
methods.description: Returns the boundary delimiter used in multipart form data.
